summary_bullets: Design-log PR publishing now uses a checks-only Python CI/merge bridge with bounded failed-run reruns instead of the brittle single-shot watch gate.
Required-check classification now fails closed for non-pass required rows while preserving existing optional-check behavior for ship-pr callers.
Design-log publish documentation and harness coverage now pin repository resolution, bridge output parsing, merge cwd separation, and removal of legacy watch semantics.
commit_message:
Add design-log CI merge bridge

Add a checks-only design-log ship helper that waits on required checks, reruns one failed required run with bounded log-readiness and stale-row settle handling, and transient-retries the squash admin merge from the consumer repo root.

Thread required-check mode through ci_monitor, add delete-branch support to gh.pr_merge, and wire python/cli.py ship design-log into design-log-publish.sh.

Update Python and shell harness coverage plus docs for the new bridge and fail-closed required-check classification.
